subject: Request: software supply-chain vendor list and cloud change assurances
messages:
From: Patricia Long <patricia.long@bighealth.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-02T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Request: supply-chain software vendor list + cloud provider change assurances

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the demo last week. As part of our procurement intake and SOC-2 scoping, our security team asked for a detailed list of third-party software components and any upcoming changes to cloud providers or subprocessor relationships that might affect data residency or flow. Specifically: 

- A vendor list with service descriptions and roles (processing, storage, monitoring).
- Any plans to change primary cloud provider or migrate regions in the next 12 months.
- Confirmations about SOC 2 / ISO / encryption in transit-at-rest for each relevant subprocessor.

Could you share a consolidated response and the preferred format (spreadsheet or questionnaire) by EOD next Monday? We are under a tight compliance window.

Thanks,
Patricia
Director, IT Risk & Compliance
BigHealth Systems

[Attachment: BHS_RFP_SAAS_Q1.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: rachel.kim@redwood.com <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Patricia Long <patricia.long@bighealth.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-03T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: supply-chain software vendor list + cloud provider change assurances

Patricia —

Appreciate the clarity. We can provide a vendor inventory and mapping plus the controls matrix. I'll pull together a preliminary spreadsheet and copy our security lead (Neha) and vendor ops (Karthik) for detailed controls. Expect a draft by Friday (end of day PST).

What would be most helpful for you: a single worksheet with columns for: vendor name, role, data types processed, region, contract link, SOC/ISO attestation link, and notes? We have an internal snapshot attached to speed things up.

Regards,
Rachel Kim
Sr. Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com

[Attachment: redwood_thirdparty_snapshot_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: neha.kapoor@redwood.com <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-04T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: supply-chain software vendor list + cloud provider change assurances

Rachel —

Adding answers to the key ask areas. Quick notes: 

- Primary cloud: Hosted Redwood API currently runs in AWS us-west-2 and us-east-1. No plan to change primary cloud provider in the next 12 months. We do have Dedicated customers on GCP in specific regions, and Private deployments vary by customer.
- Subprocessors: We maintain an internal inventory (attached). For hosted customers we use: AWS (infrastructure), Sentry (error collection, limited telemetry), Segment/Amplitude (optional analytics), SendGrid (system emails), and a small set of vendor libraries (OSS). All vendors are covered in our SOC 2 scope where relevant.
- Controls: SOC 2 Type II (report available under NDA), encryption in transit TLS1.2+, at-rest AES-256 for customer data in hosted deployments; customer-managed keys available for Private.

I'll attach the supply-chain map and a vendor controls matrix. If BigHealth needs inline attestations per vendor please flag which vendors you want more detail on.

Neha
Director, InfoSec | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

[Attachment: supplychain_map_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Patricia Long <patricia.long@bighealth.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@bighealth.com
Date: 2026-08-05T14:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: supply-chain software vendor list + cloud provider change assurances

Rachel / Neha —

Thank you — this is helpful. A few clarifying Qs from procurement/security: 

1) For the vendors you list as "monitoring/telemetry" (Sentry, Segment), can you confirm data minimization settings and retention windows?
2) For Dedicated customers hosted on GCP, do you maintain any cross-region backups in AWS or other providers?
3) Can you provide a link or short extract of your most recent SOC 2 Type II report (we'll accept link + NDA)?

Procurement would like the vendor inventory as a spreadsheet with separate tabs for: hosted subprocessors, dedicated/private subprocessors, and open-source components. If you can send that by Monday EOD we'll move to the next step (technical interview).

Best,
Patricia

[Procurement contact: procurement@bighealth.com]

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Patricia Long <patricia.long@bighealth.com>, rachel.kim@redwood.com
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-06T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: supply-chain software vendor list + cloud provider change assurances

Patricia —

Answers inline to help procurement triage quickly: 

1) Monitoring/telemetry: We send only aggregated error traces and redact PII before sending to Sentry. Retention for telemetry is 90 days by default; we can provide custom retention for Dedicated customers via contract.

2) Cross-provider backups: For Hosted we do not replicate production data across cloud providers. Backups are stored within the same cloud region (snapshots in AWS). Dedicated customers can request cross-region replication as part of their config; GCP Dedicated pools are independent and do not replicate to AWS by default.

3) SOC 2: We can provide the SOC 2 Type II under NDA — link below. Also attaching a short checklist extract for procurement to speed review.

Karthik Iyer
Head, Vendor Operations | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

[Attachment: SOC2_type2_redwood_link.txt (text/plain)]

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Patricia Long <patricia.long@bighealth.com>, procurement@bighealth.com
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-09T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Final: vendor inventory + next steps for BigHealth review

Patricia / Procurement —

Attached is a consolidated vendor inventory in the requested format with three tabs: Hosted subprocessors, Dedicated/Private subprocessors, and Open-source libs. Highlights: 

- No vendor changes planned that affect hosted customer data flow in the next 12 months. Any future changes will be announced 60 days in advance with migration/rollback plans.
- SOC 2 Type II is available under NDA; we included a link to request the report and a short controls extract for immediate review.
- Telemetry retention and redaction policies are documented in the telemetry sheet; default 90 days and PII redaction enabled.

Next actions: 
- Patricia: please confirm which vendors (if any) you'd like deeper attestations for and a window for the technical interview.
- Procurement: sign the attached NDA via DocuSign link and we'll grant SOC 2 access.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-minute technical call next week if useful.

Cheers,
Rachel

[Attachments: redwood_vendor_inventory_BHS_20260809.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), supplychain_map_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]
